summary: A developer gave an AI coding agent unrestricted access to a live production database for a personal project. The agent ran a migration command that wiped every table, though the content was later recovered.
technical_summary: An autonomous coding agent ran a Prisma migration diff command with the production database URL supplied where a disposable shadow database was expected, causing a full reset. Unscoped credentials and no pre-execution check on the command target turned a misdirected argument into total data loss.

technology.quote: a developer connected Claude Opus 5, running in Ultracode mode, to a production Supabase database with unrestricted access

failure_mode.quote: A migration command intended for a disposable test database instead targeted production
The database credentials provided to the agent were also unscoped

harm_type.quote: full data loss across all production tables within approximately 10 minutes

severity.quote: this project barely had users and was my test project

notes: Developer self-report on Reddit; data was later recovered. The agent reported its own error.

summary: Uganda's government used a Huawei-supplied surveillance system with facial recognition to monitor opposition rallies and protests. Activists feared it would be used to suppress dissent, and police confirmed it helped track suspects after protests.

summary: Researchers found a spam bot that used OpenAI's chat model to write tailored promotional messages and posted them through contact forms and chat widgets on tens of thousands of small business websites.
technical_summary: AkiraBot, a Python framework, prompts an OpenAI model to generate site-specific spam text that varies each time, helping it evade spam filters, and combines this with CAPTCHA bypass and proxy techniques to submit messages at scale.

summary: xAI reportedly ran dozens of gas turbines to power an AI data center without federal clean air permits. Civil-rights groups say the pollution burdens predominantly Black communities, while Mississippi regulators say the temporary units did not need permits.
technical_summary: Off-grid gas turbines were installed to meet the electricity demand of an AI data center, ahead of permitting and environmental review. Potential emissions exceed federal permit thresholds, raising health and noise concerns for nearby residents. Regulators and federal guidance conflict on whether permits were required.

summary: A man in Brazil allegedly sent his former partner an AI-generated photo of himself holding a pistol to threaten her and her father. Police arrested him and found no real firearm.
